bio: Simplicity leads the way at this endearing restaurant set just a short stroll from the River Tisza. The room has an unfussy lodge style and there’s plenty of outdoor space courtesy of both a front and rear terrace. Cooking is fresh and well-executed, and offers something for everyone, from Hungarian classics to pizzas, burgers and street food. The wood-fired oven plays a key role, and everything is prepared with love and care....
